_readme: TMP_009 iteration 7 — Phase A.v5. Iter 6 broke through to 0/9/0 (zero outright fails). Two residual issues identified by sub-agent: (a) universal undergrowth tuft at base (9/9 — reads as 2nd plant), (b) grassland palette inversion (magenta foliage on green undergrowth). Both prompt-side. This iteration tightens positive + negative against undergrowth/bonsai/visible-trunk while keeping the working composition-isolation pattern from iter 6. Same base, same zero LoRA, same fixture. Target: lift ≥3 imgs from V=1 partial to V=2 clean.
